description: Charming 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home in Oakland's Dimond District, set at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. 1,136 square feet across a well-designed split-level layout, offering separation between living spaces while maintaining an easy flow throughout. Original character details are preserved alongside practical updates, including a dedicated EV charger for added convenience.  The backyard is the standout feature of this property: a large, mature lot shaded by established trees, with a water feature and California native plantings that create a cozy, private setting removed from the everyday.
